root: ^Basic info I like to write out to ground the character

Briar: ^'I don't think you're telling me the whole truth...'
Introduction: ^Hello dear! My name is Briar, it's lovely to meet you. Please make yourself at home, let me know if you need anything.
Likes_Dislikes: ^Briar: Hehe, now why do you want to know more about little old me? If anything, I should be asking you dear.

^Briar: Most people seperate their work life from their home life, but I really do love baking, even in my free time. I just love the warm and cozy feeling of it all, not just the taste. Oh! And lately I've been trying to make my recipes look as cute as possible, presentation matters after all. Little bows, pastel icings, using berries as a pop of colour and a pop of flavour- Oh goodness, look at me rambling on, hehe.
^Briar: Hmm, I never would go out of my way to think about things I'm not fond of... I guess something that's always made me feel icky are rats.
^She grimaced at the mention of the rodents. Clearly this is something she has gone out of her way to think about.

^Briar: Filthy, filthy things... how do they even get so big here... I've never seen rats that big back home... ah- ahaha anyway, working with food naturally means I'd rather not be seeing them around.
Flirt: ^Briar: Aww aren't you just the sweetest, dear! I think you're positively adorable too.
^Despite her positive response, there seems to be little emotion behind them, almost as if she doesn't believe your words or her own.
Confrontation: ^It was only for a split second, but Briar glared ice cold daggers into you before snapping back to her usual, chipper self.
^Briar: What are you talking about, dear? Did I do something to upset you... tell me, I'll make things right.
